reevaluation: This finding is fixed upstream and should not be filed. The review's fixedAfter: no was correct on 2026-08-15 and is wrong as of today: PR #3135 was rebased from its docs/envelope-openapi-descriptions base onto main and merged at 2026-08-19 09:28:55 UTC as d42254ff5, which sits inside tag v2.17.0 cut the same day, and the published page already serves the corrected body. The review's characterisation of the defect was exactly right and its recommended fix is what shipped, including the nested selector, the 1-20 cap, the numeric documentId/templateId variants and the previously absent response section. The product contract was never at fault and is unchanged. Nothing about the verdict changes, only its disposition: from unreported-and-open to fixed-in-release.
notes: Worth carrying forward for the report rather than for a filing: the two-week 'community docs PRs sit unmerged' narrative needs updating for Documenso, since three of the seven merged on 2026-08-19 (#3133, #3134, #3135), all approved by dguyen on 2026-08-03 and merged 16 days later. The remaining four (#3136, #3137, #3138, #3139) are still open. Also note #3135 shipped more than this finding: a new Cancel Document section, a CANCELLED status row, removal of the nonexistent source: "API" enum value, and the pagination corrections that D14 partly depends on.
